product_summary: LINC Limited (Kolkata, West Bengal) is a writing-instruments / stationery manufacturer, not a food or FMCG company. Its known product lines are ball pens, gel pens, roller pens, fountain pens, refills, markers/highlighters, pencils and mechanical pencils, plus school/office stationery (notebooks, registers, files, gift/promotional stationery sets). Suggested corrections/additions: 960820 (felt-tipped and porous-tipped pens, markers, highlighters), 960840 (propelling/mechanical pencils), 960850 (sets of articles from two or more of 9608-9609), 960860 (refills for ball pens), 960910 (pencils with leads encased in a rigid sheath), 960920 (pencil leads), 960990 (crayons, pastels, chalks, other writing/drawing articles), 482010/482090 (registers, notebooks, letter pads), 482110 (printed paper labels, if supplied), 392610 (office/school supplies of plastics).
